title: Test at the right layer
summary: Run fast in-process tests first, add validator-compatible integration tests where behavior depends on RPC or live state, and practice known program vulnerabilities explicitly.

links.description: Run fast in-process transaction and program tests from Rust, TypeScript, or Python.
Use a minified SVM for precise Rust instruction-level tests with explicit accounts and checks.
Run RPC-level and integration workflows with a test-validator-compatible local network and just-in-time account loading.
Practice signer, ownership, account-initialization, PDA, and CPI failure modes before review.
